title: Trace a decision through the autonomy loop
description: Change the evidence path, sensing reliability, and planning posture. The workbench recomputes state uncertainty, stopping distance, clearance, and the authority granted to the controller.

scenarios.label: Warehouse aisle crossing
scenarios.detail: A mobile robot approaches a partly occluded aisle intersection while carrying a load.

scenarios.label: Inspection drone approach
scenarios.detail: A drone approaches a structure while glare weakens visual depth cues and wind changes its motion.

scenarios.label: Sidewalk delivery merge
scenarios.detail: A low-speed delivery robot must merge around a blind corner with intermittent pedestrian detections.

evidenceModes.label: Single-frame estimate
evidenceModes.detail: Use the latest observation without temporal memory or redundant sensing.

evidenceModes.label: Tracked belief state
evidenceModes.detail: Fuse recent observations with motion prediction and explicit covariance.

evidenceModes.label: Redundant sensor fusion
evidenceModes.detail: Cross-check independent modalities and carry disagreement into the state estimate.

planningModes.label: Progress-first plan
planningModes.detail: Keep nominal speed and use a smaller clearance reserve.

planningModes.label: Balanced plan
planningModes.detail: Reduce speed while preserving the nominal clearance requirement.

planningModes.label: Conservative plan
planningModes.detail: Trade task progress for slower motion and a larger clearance reserve.
